description:
Checks the full flow for a 3-passenger booking on a UK departure where the delay is too short to pay compensation. Flight AC 865 LHR ? YUL arrives 2 hours 30 minutes late for a controllable reason (Code 68 � Flight Crew Shortage / Crew Rest). The trip starts in the UK, so the UK regime (EU 261 UK branch) applies, and APPR also applies because the flight lands in Canada. Neither regime pays for delays under 3 hours, so all 3 passengers are NOT ELIGIBLE and the amount is 0. Confirms that DDS returns an EU not-eligible response and the bot declines the claim in the chat with the reason, without sending it to manual review. It also confirms that no Cash or AC Wallet offer, CyberSource check, Persona IDV, payment email request or compensation record happens, and that the Claims Dashboard shows the Not Eligible outcome for all 3 passengers.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TC003 � 3 passengers: Catherine Bouchard (Adult - Claimant, Basic Aeroplan Member 9876543210), Alexandre Bouchard (Adult), Sophie Bouchard (Child). Journey: 1 leg AC international LHR ? YUL (Flight AC 865). Departure country: United Kingdom. Scheduled arrival: 14:00. Actual arrival: 16:30 (2hr 30min delay). Arrival delay code: 68 (Flight Crew Shortage / Crew Rest � Controllable). Flight status: Arrived (operated). Disruption notice: less than 14 days before departure. Booking changes: None � no VOL or INVOL. Carrier: AC only. 72hrs: Elapsed (filed D+13). Time limit: Within 2190 days (UK 6-year limit). No duplicate case. Not employee. Aeroplan: Linked (9876543210), Basic Member in good standing. Country of residence: Canada.
